name: yangweijie/typephp-gui
description: Run tinyjsapp desktop apps on a compiled PHP backend (aot-compiler / TypePHP) instead of a JS module graph.

scripts-descriptions.tiers: Run the POSIX verification kit (host probe + tiers 1-2 + launch mode + stderr isolation).
scripts-descriptions.verify: Verify a packaged dist/ bundle: launcher subsystem, bundled launcher, DLL set.
scripts-descriptions.patches:status: Report whether the tinyjsapp checkout is pristine, patched, or has drifted.
scripts-descriptions.patches:apply: Rebuild cli.js and launcher-win.cc from patches/base/ plus our patches.
scripts-descriptions.patches:restore: Restore cli.js and launcher-win.cc to pristine upstream v0.42.0.
